name: Brand
title: The Burning Vengeance

passive.name: Blaze

description.normalized: Brand's abilities set enemies Ablaze, dealing 3% of their max Health as magic damage over 4 seconds. Stacking Ablaze 3 times on champions and large monsters causes them to detonate after 2 seconds, dealing 10% (+0.02% AP) of each nearby enemy's max Health as magic damage Enemies that detonate cannot stack Ablaze again within 4 seconds.

passive.rawParsedText:
Brand's abilities set enemies Ablaze, dealing 3% of their max Health as magic damage over 4 seconds.

Stacking Ablaze 3 times on champions and large monsters causes them to detonate after 2 seconds, dealing 10% (+0.02% AP) of each nearby enemy's max Health as magic damage

Enemies that detonate cannot stack Ablaze again within 4 seconds.

q.name: Sear

description.normalized: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 (+55% AP) magic damage to the first enemy it hits. If the target is ablaze, the target will be stunned for 1.75 seconds.

q.rawParsedText: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 (+55% AP) magic damage to the first enemy it hits. If the target is ablaze, the target will be stunned for 1.75 seconds.

w.name: Pillar of Flame

description.normalized: After a short delay, Brand creates a pillar of flame at a target area, dealing 70 / 120 / 170 / 220 (+55% AP) magic damage to enemy units within the area. Units that are ablaze take 30% additional damage.

w.rawParsedText: After a short delay, Brand creates a pillar of flame at a target area, dealing 70 / 120 / 170 / 220 (+55% AP) magic damage to enemy units within the area. Units that are ablaze take 30% additional damage.

e.name: Conflagration

description.normalized: Brand sets the target enemy aflame which also spreads to all enemies near them, dealing 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 (+45% AP) magic damage. When a target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread radius is doubled.

e.rawParsedText: Brand sets the target enemy aflame which also spreads to all enemies near them, dealing 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 (+45% AP) magic damage. When a target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread radius is doubled.

r.name: Pyroclasm

description.normalized: Releases a torrent of flame that bounces up to 5 times between enemies or himself, each bounce dealing 100 / 200 / 300 (+30% AP) magic damage. Blaze: Pyroclasm briefly slows by 30% / 40% / 50% if the target is ablaze. Bounces attempt to max stack Blaze on champions.
